name: exploded-aeropress-pareto-26.10-preview-s3-r2
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of an AeroPress coffee maker, as an SVG. Use the original model with a round paper filter rather than the Go or the XL.

source.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1000 1400" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="dark" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#4a5158"/><stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#23272c"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#14171a"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="plastic" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#eef1f3"/><stop offset="0.55" stop-color="#ccd4da"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#a9b4bd"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="smoke" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#a6afb7"/><stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#7b848c"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#5d666e"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="rubber" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#3f434a"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#22252a"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <pattern id="grid" width="50" height="50" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <path d="M50 0H0V50" fill="none" stroke="#7c8894" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.09"/>
    </pattern>
    <marker id="arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="7.5" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M0 0 L10 5 L0 10 Z" fill="#b3543f"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- sheet -->
  <rect width="1000" height="1400" fill="#f7f5f0"/>
  <rect width="1000" height="1400" fill="url(#grid)"/>
  <rect x="18" y="18" width="964" height="1364" rx="14" fill="none" stroke="#23282e" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.9"/>

  <!-- title block -->
  <text x="70" y="92" font-size="38" font-weight="bold" fill="#23282e">AeroPress® Coffee Maker</text>
  <text x="72" y="122" font-size="15" fill="#6a737c">Exploded assembly diagram · original model, round paper micro-filter</text>

  <!-- centerline -->
  <line x1="450" y1="134" x2="450" y2="1346" stroke="#9aa4ad" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="7 9"/>

  <!-- ============ MUG ============ -->
  <ellipse cx="452" cy="1318" rx="138" ry="13" fill="#23282e" opacity="0.07"/>
  <path d="M345,1162 L357,1292 A 93 16 0 0 0 543,1292 L555,1162 A 105 21 0 0 0 345,1162 Z"
        fill="#e7e0d2" stroke="#a89f92" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M552,1192 C618,1186 622,1268 552,1264" fill="none" stroke="#a89f92" stroke-width="19" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M552,1192 C618,1186 622,1268 552,1264" fill="none" stroke="#e7e0d2" stroke-width="11" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="1162" rx="105" ry="21" fill="#d9d1c4" stroke="#a89f92" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="1163" rx="92" ry="17" fill="#c4bbaa" opacity="0.8"/>
  <rect x="378" y="1185" width="12" height="88" rx="6" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- ============ PAPER FILTER ============ -->
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="1079" rx="78" ry="15.5" fill="#e3dac2" stroke="#cfc5a8" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="1072" rx="78" ry="15.5" fill="#fdfaf0" stroke="#d6cbae" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="1072" rx="58" ry="11" fill="none" stroke="#e0d6b8" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3 5"/>

  <!-- ============ FILTER CAP ============ -->
  <path d="M355,940 L355,988 A 95 20 0 0 0 545,988 L545,940 A 95 20 0 0 0 355,940 Z"
        fill="url(#smoke)" stroke="#4a525a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="940" rx="95" ry="20" fill="#8b949c" stroke="#4a525a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="944" rx="70" ry="13.5" fill="#79828a" stroke="#565e66" stroke-width="1"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="941" rx="82" ry="17" fill="none" stroke="#5d666e" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="5 6" opacity="0.9"/>
  <path d="M538,941 Q602,944 598,959 Q594,973 539,975 Z" fill="url(#smoke)" stroke="#4a525a" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- ============ CHAMBER ============ -->
  <path d="M365,540 L390,798 L376,803 L374,821 L389,826 L393,850
           A 57 12 0 0 0 507,850
           L511,826 L526,821 L524,803 L510,798 L535,540
           A 85 16 0 0 0 365,540 Z"
        fill="url(#plastic)" opacity="0.95" stroke="#77828c" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="540" rx="85" ry="16" fill="#aeb7bf" stroke="#77828c" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="540" rx="76" ry="12.5" fill="#d6dce1"/>
  <rect x="382" y="565" width="14" height="230" rx="7" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.35"/>
  <!-- fill-level markings -->
  <g stroke="#8d98a2" stroke-width="1">
    <line x1="388" y1="765" x2="410" y2="765"/>
    <line x1="388" y1="720" x2="410" y2="720"/>
    <line x1="388" y1="675" x2="410" y2="675"/>
    <line x1="388" y1="630" x2="410" y2="630"/>
  </g>
  <g font-size="11" fill="#77828c">
    <text x="418" y="769">1</text><text x="418" y="724">2</text>
    <text x="418" y="679">3</text><text x="418" y="634">4</text>
  </g>
  <text transform="translate(514,762) rotate(-90)" font-size="13" letter-spacing="5" fill="#8d98a2">AEROPRESS</text>

  <!-- ============ PLUNGER ============ -->
  <rect x="360" y="152" width="180" height="30" rx="15" fill="url(#dark)" stroke="#14171a" stroke-width="1"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="152" rx="90" ry="14" fill="url(#dark)" stroke="#14171a" stroke-width="1"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="149" rx="68" ry="7" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.10"/>
  <path d="M408,180 L414,200 L486,200 L492,180 Z" fill="url(#dark)" stroke="#14171a" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="412" y="198" width="76" height="208" fill="url(#dark)" stroke="#14171a" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="420" y="204" width="12" height="192" rx="6" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.14"/>
  <path d="M400,404 L500,404 L500,432 Q500,456 476,458 L424,458 Q400,456 400,432 Z"
        fill="url(#rubber)" stroke="#17191c" stroke-width="1"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="404" rx="50" ry="8" fill="#4d525a" stroke="#17191c" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="404" y1="421" x2="496" y2="421" stroke="#15181b" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.55"/>
  <line x1="404" y1="435" x2="496" y2="435" stroke="#15181b" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.55"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="456" rx="44" ry="6" fill="#000000" opacity="0.22"/>

  <!-- ============ STIRRER (left) ============ -->
  <rect x="118" y="285" width="22" height="160" rx="11" fill="url(#plastic)" stroke="#77828c" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="106" y="430" width="46" height="78" rx="22" fill="url(#plastic)" stroke="#77828c" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="124" y1="292" x2="124" y2="420" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.35"/>

  <!-- ============ SCOOP (left, below stirrer) ============ -->
  <rect x="118" y="552" width="20" height="102" rx="10" fill="url(#plastic)" stroke="#77828c" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M97,655 Q99,702 135,705 Q171,702 173,655 A 38 12 0 0 1 97,655 Z"
        fill="url(#plastic)" stroke="#77828c" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="135" cy="655" rx="38" ry="12" fill="#b9c2ca" stroke="#77828c" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- ============ FUNNEL (right, below legend) ============ -->
  <path d="M705,505 L778,635 L778,690 A 27 7 0 0 0 832,690 L832,635 L905,505 A 100 20 0 0 0 705,505 Z"
        fill="url(#plastic)" opacity="0.92" stroke="#77828c" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="805" cy="505" rx="100" ry="20" fill="#b9c2ca" stroke="#77828c" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="805" cy="505" rx="88" ry="16.5" fill="#d7dde2"/>
  <path d="M727,555 Q805,568 883,555" fill="none" stroke="#a9b3bc" stroke-width="1.3" opacity="0.7"/>
  <path d="M752,600 Q805,610 858,600" fill="none" stroke="#a9b3bc" stroke-width="1.3" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- ============ ASSEMBLY ARROWS ============ -->
  <g stroke="#b3543f" stroke-width="2.5">
    <line x1="450" y1="466" x2="450" y2="512" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
    <line x1="450" y1="870" x2="450" y2="912" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
    <line x1="450" y1="1016" x2="450" y2="1048" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
    <line x1="450" y1="1102" x2="450" y2="1130" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
  </g>
  <text x="466" y="497" font-size="12" font-style="italic" fill="#b3543f">press to assemble</text>

  <!-- ============ PART BADGES + LEADERS ============ -->
  <g stroke="#8a94a0" stroke-width="1.2">
    <line x1="566" y1="166" x2="542" y2="166"/>
    <line x1="563" y1="640" x2="528" y2="640"/>
    <line x1="314" y1="952" x2="353" y2="952"/>
    <line x1="314" y1="1072" x2="371" y2="1072"/>
    <line x1="90"  y1="300" x2="121" y2="300"/>
    <line x1="929" y1="560" x2="878" y2="560"/>
    <line x1="87"  y1="655" x2="96"  y2="655"/>
    <line x1="650" y1="1215" x2="621" y2="1215"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <g fill="#23282e" stroke="#f7f5f0" stroke-width="2">
      <circle cx="578" cy="166" r="12"/><circle cx="575" cy="640" r="12"/>
      <circle cx="302" cy="952" r="12"/><circle cx="302" cy="1072" r="12"/>
      <circle cx="78" cy="300" r="12"/><circle cx="941" cy="560" r="12"/>
      <circle cx="75" cy="655" r="12"/><circle cx="662" cy="1215" r="12"/>
    </g>
    <g font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">
      <text x="578" y="170">1</text><text x="575" y="644">2</text>
      <text x="302" y="956">3</text><text x="302" y="1076">4</text>
      <text x="78" y="304">5</text><text x="941" y="564">6</text>
      <text x="75" y="659">7</text><text x="662" y="1219">8</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ PARTS LIST ============ -->
  <rect x="690" y="88" width="278" height="332" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.75" stroke="#d8d2c6" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="714" y="120" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" letter-spacing="3" fill="#8a8378">PARTS LIST</text>
  <g fill="#23282e">
    <circle cx="724" cy="152" r="11"/><circle cx="724" cy="185" r="11"/>
    <circle cx="724" cy="218" r="11"/><circle cx="724" cy="251" r="11"/>
    <circle cx="724" cy="284" r="11"/><circle cx="724" cy="317" r="11"/>
    <circle cx="724" cy="350" r="11"/><circle cx="724" cy="383" r="11"/>
  </g>
  <g font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">
    <text x="724" y="156">1</text><text x="724" y="189">2</text>
    <text x="724" y="222">3</text><text x="724" y="255">4</text>
    <text x="724" y="288">5</text><text x="724" y="321">6</text>
    <text x="724" y="354">7</text><text x="724" y="387">8</text>
  </g>
  <g font-size="15" fill="#3a4048">
    <text x="746" y="157">Plunger</text>
    <text x="746" y="190">Chamber</text>
    <text x="746" y="223">Filter cap</text>
    <text x="746" y="256">Paper filter (round)</text>
    <text x="746" y="289">Stirrer</text>
    <text x="746" y="322">Funnel</text>
    <text x="746" y="355">Scoop</text>
    <text x="746" y="388" fill="#8a8378">Mug (not included)</text>
  </g>

  <!-- footer -->
  <text x="70" y="1362" font-size="12" letter-spacing="3" fill="#8a94a0">FIG. 1 — EXPLODED VIEW</text>
  <text x="500" y="1362" font-size="13" font-style="italic" fill="#6a737c" text-anchor="middle">Assembly order: mug → cap + paper filter → chamber → plunger</text>
</svg>
